name: Luelmo (Spain)
description: Four diagonal bands of blue, red, yellow and green from the lower hoist to the upper fly, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Luelmo.
history: The new arms and flag of Luelmo were approved by the town council in session on 25 March 2002, published provisionally in the provincial bulletin on 19 April 2002, in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 6 June 2002 and definitively in the provincial bulletin on 12 June 2002; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:4, formed of four oblique stripes in proportion 1:4, from the fly green, gold, red and blue, with the municipal arms at the centre.
